items.question: How many days per week can full-time employees work remotely?
items.ground_truth: Full-time employees may work remotely up to three days per week, subject to manager approval.

items.question: How many paid vacation days do employees accrue each year?
items.ground_truth: Employees accrue twenty days of paid vacation leave each year.

items.question: What is the deadline for submitting business expenses for reimbursement?
items.ground_truth: Business expenses must be submitted within thirty days of purchase, with itemized receipts.

items.question: What temperature range must temperature-sensitive cold chain shipments be kept within?
items.ground_truth: Temperature-sensitive shipments must be kept between two and eight degrees Celsius.

items.question: How soon must damaged goods be reported to the warehouse supervisor after delivery?
items.ground_truth: Damaged goods must be reported to the warehouse supervisor within twenty-four hours of delivery.

items.question: What must happen to every outbound pallet before it leaves the loading dock?
items.ground_truth: Every outbound pallet must be scanned and assigned a tracking number before it leaves the loading dock.
